about: Images known to be generated rather than photographed, by content hash. scripts/scan-assets.mjs marks any published file whose contents match one of these hashes as generated, whatever its path, so a generated image cannot lose its label by being moved, and a real photograph dropped in at the same path loses it without anyone editing this list. Paths under asset-pack/ are withdrawn images, listed so that one put back is labelled. Remove an entry when its published file is replaced by a photograph; the scan warns when one is stale.
